Name: Farm Rearranger - Move buildings from your farm
Author: CherryChain
Description:
This mod adds an item that lets you rearrange buildings from the farm without having to visit Robin's shop.


[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]How to use[/size][/b]
When you reach 8 hearts with Robin, she adds a new Farm Rearranger item to her shop. When purchased and placed on your farm (or anywhere else with moveable buildings), you can interact with it to open the move-buildings view anytime.

You can optionally use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change the price and friendship requirements.

[b][size=5]Common questions[/size][/b]
[quote][size=3][b]Is the mod still compatible?[/b][/size]
The mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Does the mod conflict with any others?[/b][/size]
There are no known mod conflicts. Feel free to report compatibility issues in the mod comments.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Can I safely add/remove the mod anytime?[/b][/size]
Yep, the mod makes no custom changes to your save.[/quote]
